quests.instruction: Listen to the sentence and track how pitch rises or falls across each word.

quests.explanation: The opening phrase 'after the meeting' prepares the main idea, so the voice lifts slightly on 'meeting'. Falling there would split the sentence into two statements.
quests.rule: Intonation curves are grammatical and emotional signals in English. Statements drop at the terminal syllable (finality); questions rise (anticipation).
quests.proTip: Anchor your listening on the tonic syllable (the last stressed word in the clause). That is where the pitch rollercoaster makes its decisive shift.
quests.hint: The sentence has an opening phrase and a main clause. Listen for the boundary between them.
